import numpy as np
import scipy.special

class TsodyksMarkram(Model):

    J = NArray(
        label=r":math:`J`",
        default=np.array([3.07]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.0, hi=10.0, step=1.0),
        doc="""Synaptic coupling strength""",

    alpha = NArray(
        label=r":math:`alpha`",

        doc="""Softplus nonlinearity steepness (smoothed threshold gain)""",

    E0 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`E0`",
        default=np.array([-2.0]),
        domain=Range(lo=-10.0, hi=2.0, step=1.0),
        doc="""External input (baseline excitability)""",
    )
    tau = NArray(
        label=r":math:`tau`",
        default=np.array([0.013]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.001, hi=0.1, step=1.0),
        doc="""Membrane time constant (firing rate relaxation)""",
    )
    tauD = NArray(
        label=r":math:`tauD`",
        default=np.array([0.2]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.01, hi=1.0, step=1.0),
        doc="""Synaptic depression recovery time constant""",
    )
    tauF = NArray(
        label=r":math:`tauF`",
        default=np.array([1.5]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.1, hi=5.0, step=1.0),
        doc="""Synaptic facilitation decay time constant""",

    U0 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`U0`",
        default=np.array([0.3]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.0, hi=1.0, step=1.0),

    _nvar = 3

    state_variable_range = Final(

    variables_of_interest = List(

        choices=("E", "x", "u"),

    parameter_names = List(
        of=str,
        label="List of parameters for this model",
        default=["J", "alpha", "E0", "tau", "tauD", "tauF", "U0"],
    )

    local_parameter_names = []

    state_variable_dfuns = Final(
        label="Drift functions",
        default={
            "E": "(SS1 - E)/tau",
            "x": "(1 - x)/tauD - E*u*x",
            "u": "(U0 - u)/tauF + E*U0*(1 - u)",
        },

    cvar = np.array([], dtype=np.int32)

    coupling_terms = Final(label="Coupling terms", default=[])

    _R = None
    _stimulus = 0.0
    use_numba = False

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        E = state_variables[0, :]
        x = state_variables[1, :]
        u = state_variables[2, :]

        J = self.J
        alpha = self.alpha
        E0 = self.E0
        tau = self.tau
        tauD = self.tauD
        tauF = self.tauF
        U0 = self.U0

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)

        # Derived Variables
        self.SS0 = SS0 = E0 + E * J * u * x
        self.SS1 = SS1 = alpha * np.log(1 + np.exp(SS0 / alpha))

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray((SS1 - E) / tau),  # E
            np.asarray((1 - x) / tauD - E * u * x),  # x
            np.asarray((U0 - u) / tauF + E * U0 * (1 - u)),  # u
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
